notes.title: Changes and Interpretation of the Vocational Skills System
notes.notes:
This update has reclassified skill types, and each profession can only use skills that are unique to their own profession. Non professional skills previously learned after job transfer will no longer be usable. Skills will not be remade or cleared. (Passive skills will always be retained)
The skills obtained from the skill book will be retained indefinitely without being restricted by profession.

notes.title: Large version updates
notes.notes:
Main update content:
1. Open a new area called "Lava Purgatory", where players can trigger teleportation points to enter the new area after opening the coffin of the underground cemetery.
2. Add 4 independent maps, 9 new enemies/BOSS, 7 new equipment, and 2 new learnable skills.
3. Add new storylines, NPCs, and interactive methods.
4. Fixed incorrect calculation of defense/magic defense in some skill calculation formulas.
5. Fixed an issue where the passive skill "magic defense increase" failed to correctly increase magic defense.
6. Fixed abnormal issues with the Heavenly Ladder teleportation array.
7. Adjusted the acquisition location of the "Devil Energy Source" in the Heavenly Stairway area, allowing players to enter the new area lava purgatory earlier.
8. Enhanced some skill data for Berserker and Swordsman.
9. Due to the opening of the new DLC, the strength of the "former" enemies has been increased.
10. Adjusted the opening plot.
11. Added passive skills that can be learned at levels 40-50-60.
Finally, due to the replacement of the Steam verification device, the version update has been delayed. We apologize and thank all players for their patience. At the same time, the game is still continuously updated, and thank you all for your support!
